messages:
Maya (Arclight): hey all ":wave:" kicking off Arclight onboarding. Goals: 1) auto-generate incident summaries for meter anomalies, 2) provide vector search over 6 months of logs, and 3) reach 800 req/day in pilot. POC: Maya. Need owners + 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): hi Maya, Ill own CS coordination. Quick Q: any hard SLA for latency/accuracy tied to renewal?

Maya (Arclight): yes — renewal depends on summary accuracy >= 90% on our test prompts and P95 latency <700ms. Region: eu-west.

Jon (Solutions Eng): Ill lead integration. Suggest: chat for summaries + embeddings for search. Need sample schema and token estimates.

Maya (Arclight): sending sample payload (S3) and schema. Avg tokens ~260 per event, bursts to 600 events/min.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: dev workshop day 2, ops/runbook day 12. Will share pre-read with IAM & allowlist steps.

Claire (Security): flag: retention and export controls. Marta, capture compliance contacts; may push to Private if stricter controls required.

Marta (CSM): noted. Draft success criteria: - Accuracy >=90% on gold set, - P95 <=700ms, - Stable 800 req/day with <1% errors, - Security sign-off for EU data.

Jon (Solutions Eng): engineering milestones:
Week 1: keys, allowlist, smoke test
Week 2: ingestion + embeddings + basic evals
Week 3: latency tuning + canary
Week 4: pilot + runbook handoff

Jon (Solutions Eng): sample curl for smoke test: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize meter anomaly"}'`

Marta (CSM): proposed kickoff Tue 11:00 CET or Wed 09:30 CET. Which works?

Maya (Arclight): Tue 11:00 CET works. Attendees: Maya, Leo (Eng lead), Claire, Jon, Priya, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Tue 11:00 CET — "Arclight  Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Invite sent.

Marta (CSM): CS action items: collect allowlist IPs, sample S3 link, legal contact, and finalize success criteria & acceptance tests. Any other risks?

Maya (Arclight): risk: storm bursts may cause cold-start latency. Will provide traffic trace for load tests.

Marta (CSM): good — adding load-tests to pilot plan. See you Tue. :rocket:
